instagram.caption:
Whole assignment and no idea where to start? Why "just start" fails with ADHD 📚

I wasn't lazy. I couldn't see step 1. Here's what actually works:

1. Make step 1 tiny and physical: "open the doc, type the title"
2. Break the whole assignment into steps of 10 min or less
3. Put ONLY step 1 on screen, with a short timer and calm sounds

Turns out starting was the hard part. I did 3 steps without noticing.

📌 Save this for your next assignment, and send it to a friend who's stuck on one.
💜 Try FOCO, link in bio.
